notes.zh-CN: 手机端可在会话里切换执行 Agent：Grok、OpenCode、CodeBuddy、Antigravity、Codex、Kimi、Claude、DeepSeek、Trae、MiMo、Qwen Code、Comate 之间可切换，指令经同步服务下发，电脑端会停掉旧 CLI、新开会话并带上此前转写。手机切换执行 Agent 需要把同步服务更新到本版本，未更新时仍可浏览、续聊和切换模型。错误提示保留原始详情：电脑端不再丢弃 JSON-RPC error.data 与 CLI 的 stderr，聊天里显示一句可翻译的摘要，点「查看详情」展开原文。macOS 为 universal 开发签名、未公证；Windows 安装包未签名；APK 为 debug 签名；IPA 为开发签名，仅限团队已注册设备，均非商店包。
notes.en: The phone can now switch a session's agent among Grok, OpenCode, CodeBuddy, Antigravity, Codex, Kimi, Claude, DeepSeek, Trae, MiMo, Qwen Code and Comate. The command goes through the sync service; the desktop stops the old CLI, opens a new session and carries the earlier transcript over. Switching agents on the phone needs the sync service updated to this version; browsing, replying and switching models still work before that update. Error notes keep the original details: the desktop no longer drops JSON-RPC error.data or the CLI stderr, showing a short translatable sentence with “Show details” for the raw text. macOS is universal and development-signed, not notarized; Windows installers are unsigned; APK is debug-signed; IPA is development-signed for registered team devices only. These are not store builds.
